data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net release of $4.1026 million from prior year reserves in 2014, representing a 16.35% reduction relative to its opening gross claims outstanding. This favorable development primarily stemmed from exceptional reserve releases related to the 2011 and 2012 underwriting years, contributing to a lower claims ratio. The report also noted that the 2012 underwriting year closed with a profit despite the impact of Superstorm Sandy.
